personality_one_liner: An uncompromising dark-mode command center providing real-time phishing detection, brand impersonation intelligence, and threat relationship graphs for security professionals and victims.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room with compact metric cards and touch targets >= 44pt

do's: Use solid obsidian and graphite surfaces with high contrast borders for data clarity
dont's: Avoid translucent blur layers over dense threat tables

screens.name: Role Selection & Login
screens.purpose: Authenticate user into Victim, Investigator, or Admin role with instant role-based dashboard redirection.
screens.layout: Centered secure card with role selection pills, quick-fill demo buttons, and biometric simulation.

screens.name: Victim Dashboard
screens.purpose: Provide simple URL/image scanning, 1-click reporting, safety guidance, and personal case tracking.

states.loading: Scanning target URL across Kaggle ML weights and OpenPhish feeds...
states.empty: No personal scans submitted yet. Enter a suspicious URL or upload a screenshot to begin.
states.error: Scan timed out or network error. Please retry analysis.

screens.layout: Hero scan input box, active scan progress state, recent personal scans list, and 1-click safety report button.

screens.name: Investigator Dashboard
screens.purpose: Deep case analysis, evidence collection, 0-100 risk scoring, re-upload detection, and interactive threat relationship graphs.

states.loading: Analyzing DOM fingerprints, WHOIS records, and logo similarity vectors...
states.empty: No active investigation cases in queue. Select a case from the threat feed.
states.error: Failed to load threat intelligence graph connections.

screens.layout: Metrics overview banner, threat feed with OpenPhish/PhishTank badges, case investigation queue, and node graph preview.

screens.name: Admin Platform Management
screens.purpose: Manage users, investigators, verified brands registry, global campaigns, data sources, and system analytics.

states.loading: Syncing live feeds and threat database metrics...
states.error: Database sync error. Check API keys.

screens.layout: Tabbed admin modules: Brand Registry, Data Feed Adapters (OpenPhish/Kaggle), System Health, and Role Access Control.

hero_threat_bg.alt: Cybersecurity threat intelligence dark grid backdrop

instructions_to_main_agent: Build SafeTap AI with Dark-First Utility DARK theme (Personality 7). Implement 3 distinct role logins: Victim, Investigator, and Admin with automatic redirection. Core workflow: Scan -> Detect -> Verify -> Classify -> Score -> Link -> Report. Support OpenPhish/PhishTank threat feed integration with graceful fallback demo data, Kaggle phishing dataset feature scoring, OCR & DOM clone detection, explainable 0-100 risk score breakdown, interactive threat relationship graph, evidence report generation with downloadable PDF/text logs, and zero indigo/purple/navy colors (use obsidian, carbon gray, warm amber/rust accents).
